main_text.p: prætextam exuimus, & pari passi gradimur cum viris. Divinum quid habet, Philosophi in moribus à plebe dissensio, non ægra illa & astricta; sed exercitio multo liberalis jam & robusta: Audeamus modo: Priscam cum negleCtu gravitatem præferemus redivivi Catones.

p.i: Naturam expellas furcâ, tamen usque recurret.

main_text.p: Frustrà cespitem dimoveas, & fundum pertentes ligone Rationis: Numquam erues annosum illud robur, quod tam alte demisit intricatam radicem; sin relictâ stirpe, sarmentum putes, mox pertinaciori frutice repullulat, & jacturam sui compensat cum fœnore: Non nisi sarcophago deponeS, quod sub fasciis commiserunt incunabula: tecum coaluit, non divel-

page.notes: The first line of the page reads "286 ARNOLDI GEULINCX," as printed. The word "deponeS" is printed with a capital S and is kept as printed. The word "negleCtu" is printed with a capital C and is kept as printed. The right-hand margin shows bleed-through text from the facing page and is not transcribed.
